purpose: Teach: かねて/余暇/車中/留まる/論拠/言い過ぎ/御用/競走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、かねて、絶対、より、絶対、検討してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I've been giving this case serious, sustained thought. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Measured authority. Crisp attack on opening. Deliberate pacing—each phrase lands with weight. Eyes direct. The tone of someone who has thought long and expects the same rigor in return.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、余暇、絶対、過ごし方、絶対、改善、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively working on improving how our staff spend their time and utilize their days.
lines.style: Professional, steady cadence. Respectful but not obsequious. The careful formality of reporting upward. Slight tension in the shoulders—performing competence, not just claiming it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 出張、本気で、絶対、車中、絶対、会議、絶対、効率化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure meetings during business travel are streamlined and productive.
lines.style: Direct instruction, not a request. Clipped pace. The words arranged like stepping stones—clear and deliberate. A light snap of urgency underneath the control.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、現状に、絶対、留まる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、挑戦しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our staff aren't staying comfortable with the current state. We're pushing forward on all fronts.
lines.style: Steady report-voice. Demonstrating alignment with the directive. Even pacing, slightly formal. The subtle lean-forward of someone eager to show they've heard and are acting.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 提案の、本気で、絶対、論拠、絶対、明確に、絶対、示せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When you make a proposal, spell out the reasoning. Make it clear.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The expectation sits underneath the words. Slight pause before 'spell out'—the moment where Hiroshi shifts from conversational to instructional. Eyes holding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への、本気で、絶対、言い過ぎ、絶対、ない、絶対、対応、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful not to overstate our position to clients. Every response is measured and precise.
lines.style: Calm, methodical delivery. The pride of restraint in his voice—he's not over-promising. Even tone, attentive posture. Showing that this care is deliberate, not accidental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 御用、本気で、絶対、商人、絶対、伝統、絶対、守れ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't lose sight of the merchant traditions that built this business.
lines.style: Slightly lower volume, more weight per word. A shift toward gravitas—this is about something deeper than quarterly targets. Slow enough to let it settle. The tone of inheritance and duty.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界での、本気で、絶対、競走、絶対、当社、絶対、リード、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're leading the competition in our industry. That position comes from how we work every day.
lines.style: Controlled pride. The conclusion. Clear and assured without boasting. Slightly warmer than the earlier updates—a moment of satisfaction. Stable, grounded finish.
